note: Bottomland wetland area on the Black River southeast of Poplar Bluff, managed for waterfowl. The one camping area is a small gravel lot at the river access at the south end, off County Road 240, with a privy; MDC advises checking river levels with the Otter Slough office first, since the area floods. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Individual Campsites'; brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups. One camping area (GIS 335 + ADA lot 834) at the Black River access off CR 240, with privy/ramp symbols on the 5/12/2026 map; the waterfowl refuge zones lie north of it. Gravel lot ~26 x 26 m at the river bend; pin ~25 m E in woods, so move onto the lot. Not waterfront kept (the only opening is the ramp lot). Phone matches; vault written.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map and are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' The 5/12/2026 map has one Camping Area symbol, with Privy, accessible and boat-ramp symbols, at the Black River access off CR 240 at the area's south end. GIS has one camping point (335) beside lot 834 (ADA). On imagery the lot is a gravel apron ~26 x 26 m reached by a gravel lane from CR 240, enough for a 23-ft rig; no 4WD or crossing.

FLOODING: brochure: 'Because water conditions fluctuate greatly with changing river levels, area users are advised to contact the Otter Slough Conservation Area office prior to their trip to the area. Unexpected deep water and hazardous conditions exist when the area is flooded, so use caution while wading and boating.' Put in the note.

SEASON (manual, left as stored): year-round with the note on waterfowl closures Oct 15 - Mar 1. The 5/12/2026 map's 'Waterfowl Refuge (Closed to all use Oct 15 - Mar 1)' and hunting-only zones are the hatched units 1-9 north of the camping area. The camping area at CR 240 is outside them, so the stored note is accurate as worded ('portions').
PIN: stored 36.51573,-90.36272 = GIS camping point 335, ~25 m NE of the gravel apron under trees. Suggest moving onto the apron at 36.5157,-90.3630.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept, lead): the gravel apron runs down to the Black River (~30 m wide here) at the boat ramp, so the only opening to the water is the ramp lot. Per the ramp-lane rule this isn't on-water; nothing else sits by the river.
CLUSTERS: GIS lots 831 (2.4 km N, at the CR 244 ramp) and 832 (5 km N) carry no camping point, and the map marks camping only at the south access, so there's no split.
PHONE: (573) 624-5821 on the area page matches.
